x: Ken Onuagaluchi,who has helped rejuvinate our track side with some fine performances. [Photo - Bill Laws]
Ken Onuagaluchi has improved his discus P.B. this year by 5m and in the process has taken the Belgrave discus record to over 52 metres.
Field event men were heavier and stronger than at the end of last season with John Aska and Ken Onuagaluchi atleast 30 lbs heavier and raring to go.
Our field men got us off to a great start with Terry Welsh 2nd in the hammer and Ken Onuagaluchi beating ex-International John Hillier inthe discus for the first time in a B.A.L. match.

Last but by no means least we saw Ken Onuagaluchi gain the silver in the discus behind coach Mike Winch and on the basis of this performance he was awarded his first Surrey vest for the forthcoming Inter Counties.
Ken Onuagaluchi had a field day in the throws getting 2nd in the shot and winning the shot and the discus. Roy Vassall ended up third in a classy long jump.

The highlights of this years Club Championships were Ken Onuagaluchi's new discus record which placed him in the top 5 in the UK plus Mark Sinclair's hat trick in the 800m and his forth consecutive win in the 1500m - A series of quite remarkable doubles !!
